description: Export dithering (recording plan R3, R-090 P3, decision 100) on the 2x2 plane grid: s0 the authored slow ramps (a few 8-bit steps across the tile, and a staircase inside one step) on User0 (RGB16), User1 (L16F), User2 (RGB32F), BaseColor (sRGB8, the control) and Height (L16F); s1 the height ramps at opacity 0.05 over a uniform 0.5; s2 grey A at opacity 0.02 over a uniform 0.5; s3 normal-a on Normal. Dithering on and off at PNG 8 and PNG 16, on at OpenEXR 16f, on at PNG 8 with passthrough padding; every export step done twice in the session, so the same-session repeat and r2 classify whether dithering is deterministic.
